next.reason: 1985: files in one CLOSE 'need not all have the same organization or access'. 2023 states no such restriction either: the format §2023:14.9.6.2 repeats file-name-1, and §2023:14.9.6.4 GR10 makes a multi-file CLOSE 'the same as if a separate CLOSE statement had been written for each file-name-1', so mixed organizations/access are accepted with the same per-file effect. No refusal or exception condition introduced.
